page.overview:
Who is Multi-Paul?

Kate Cha (twin sister) Unnamed mother Tsing Cha (father) The Immortal (brother-in-law)

Paul Cha, better known as Multi-Paul, is a supporting antagonist in Invincible, debuting from Season 1 and onwards. He is also Dupli-Kate's twin brother.

He is an elite assassin for the secret criminal organization, The Order, who has the ability to duplicate himself.

Paul is a young Chinese man with short black hair and gray eyes. As Multi-Paul, he wears a gray and black suit with a number emblem. All clones of Multi-Paul have a number on their suit displaying their consecutive order to all other clones.
